BiblicalUsage: A chain of wreathen work, of pure gold, is what the breastplate wears at its ends. One verse names it, in the making of the priest's garments, and the chains fasten the breastplate to the ephod.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gold chains are the picture of the priest's burden held fast, for the breastplate could not fall because it was chained to the ephod, and I hold that God fastens His people to Him the same way.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
